## ScriptEditorClient interface

The Script Editor client: one namespace per resource that has operations, plus the app's own commands. A client factory creates one from `scriptEditorContract` in the app's `/contract` entry. Its type carries the contract's resource table, [ScriptEditorResources](./script-editor_contract.scripteditorresources.md)<!-- -->, so references can be bound to it by resource; the brand has no runtime member.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface ScriptEditorClient extends ClientBrand<ScriptEditorResources>
```

**Extends:** [ClientBrand](./contracts.clientbrand.md)<!-- -->&lt;[ScriptEditorResources](./script-editor_contract.scripteditorresources.md)<!-- -->&gt;
